personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT (with botanical green infusion)
personality_one_liner: An editorial campus dining experience marrying white paper canvases, botanical green warmth, and effortless ordering.

spacing.rule: Generous magazine-like vertical spacing with tactile padding and clean hierarchy

do's: Use frosted glass header and bottom bar over scrolling content
Apply translucent tinted base for botanical warmth
dont's: Never blur form inputs or body text regions

screens.name: Welcome / Auth
screens.purpose: Immersive campus welcome with student/staff ID login, email toggle, and Google sign-in.

states.loading: Centered botanical spinner with subtle greeting fade
states.error: Banner with readable authentication message and retry CTA

screens.layout: Full-bleed botanical background photo with 3-stop vertical gradient scrim. Centered typography greeting 'Good Food, Brighter Days', segmented role toggle (Student / Staff), ID/Email input fields, Google Auth button, and sticky bottom action.

screens.name: Home / Browse Menu
screens.purpose: Discover fresh daily campus menus, category filters, and featured meals.

states.loading: Skeleton card placeholders with shimmer effect
states.empty: Botanical illustration + 'No dishes found in this category' + Reset filter CTA
states.error: Readable network error message + Refresh feed button

screens.layout: Sticky frosted glass header with search bar and student badge. Horizontal category pills filter row. Featured hero card with gradient scrim and quick add button. Single-column vertical card feed for daily specials with real food imagery and price tags.

screens.name: Item Details
screens.purpose: Customize menu items with portion sizes, dietary add-ons, and special instructions.

states.loading: Image placeholder loader + skeleton ingredient list
states.error: Failed to load item details + Retry button

screens.layout: Full-width header image with gradient scrim and floating back button. Scrollable content with Playfair display title, calorie & nutrition badges, radio selector for size/portions, checkbox add-ons list, special instruction text input, and sticky bottom Add to Cart bar.

screens.name: Cart
screens.purpose: Review selected meals, apply dining points/promos, and proceed to checkout.

states.empty: Fresh salad bowl illustration + 'Your tray is empty' + Browse Menu CTA

screens.layout: Scrollable list of cart items with quantity steppers and remove actions. Student ID charging info summary, promo code input, order subtotal breakdown, and sticky bottom Proceed to Checkout button.

screens.name: Checkout & Payment
screens.purpose: Select dining hall pickup/delivery slot and complete secure payment.

states.error: Payment failure alert + Try alternative payment method CTA

screens.layout: Step progression indicator. Pickup location selector (Student Union, Science Hall, Library Café). Payment method selector (Campus Meal Plan, Google Pay, Credit/Debit card). Order summary card and sticky bottom 'Pay & Place Order' CTA.

screens.name: Order Tracking
screens.purpose: Real-time kitchen prep and campus delivery/pickup status tracking.

states.empty: No active orders found + Order now CTA
states.error: Failed to sync order status + Reconnect button

screens.layout: Interactive status timeline (Order Placed -> Kitchen Prep -> Ready for Pickup / En Route -> Delivered). Live countdown timer card, order item summary list, and action buttons for support or reordering.

screens.name: Profile & Account
screens.purpose: Manage student/staff credentials, meal plan balances, and order history.

states.empty: No past orders + Start ordering CTA
states.error: Failed to load profile data + Retry

screens.layout: Header card with user avatar, name, campus role badge, and meal balance counter. Settings and preference list rows with tinted icon containers. Order history summary list and secure Sign Out action.

welcome_bg.alt: Fresh organic salad bowl on wooden table

hero_banner.alt: Organic avocado toast and fresh herbs

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all screens strictly adhere to the Editorial Mobile LIGHT personality with botanical green accents (#2E6F40) and paper-white canvas (#FAF9F6). Apply gradient scrims over all images with text overlays. Implement sticky primary CTAs on all transactional screens. Use real logo PNGs or high-quality image selector URLs for all food items and user avatars. Avoid indigo/purple/blue entirely.
